title: Workspace dashboard shell and live data service
goal: The Angular workspace has a dashboard view with the live session, the stream/poll feed and keyed rendering, ready for sections; the old page links to it
acceptance: A dashboard route or view in web/src signs in like live.js (session exchange, kept session, typed pairing code) and reads /api/dashboard/stream with /api/dashboard/history as the fallback poll
Section state lives in signals; lists render with @for track by id, so an unchanged poll leaves the DOM in place (a test renders the same state twice, as B-144)
Feed parsing (toSortie, toApproval, mapStatus and similar) moves to framework-free src/ helpers with unit tests; live.js keeps its copy until its section moves
The old dashboard header links to the new view; the workspace build and CSP checks pass
The workspace keeps the simple page (Nodo) as the base of the simple view (F-130-T16); the dashboard is a second layout beside it, not a replacement
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: route, session and feed service, the keyed-render pattern and the first join test. Not a measurement.
